title: VoteBan Players
description: Allows verified players to start votes to ban/kick/mute players without having mod permissions.
body:
# VoteBan

VoteBan gives your regular players a way to deal with rule-breakers when staff aren't around. Instead of just waiting for an admin to show up, players can start a vote to kick, mute, or ban someone. It uses your existing punishment commands, so it will work with any setup you already have.

## ⭐ Key Features
- Universal Compatibility: Uses your existing server commands, ensuring it works with any punishment plugin (LiteBans, AdvancedBan, EssentialsX, etc.).
- Flexible Voting: Choose between fixed vote counts or a server percentage threshold to ensure votes scale with your player base.
- Anti-Spam & Abuse Protection: Built-in "already-voted" cooldowns and VOTEBAN.BYPASS permissions prevent players from abusing the system.
- Rich Text Support: Full support for MiniMessage, allowing for clean, clickable chat interactions.
- Automated Moderation: Optional chat locking and automatic vote starting make moderation smooth and efficient.


## ✏️ Commands
### /votemute <player> [reason]
- Description: Start a vote to mute a specific player.
- Permission: VOTEBAN.STARTMUTE

### /voteban <player> [reason]
- Description: Start a vote to ban a specific player.
- Permission: VOTEBAN.STARTBAN

### /votekick <player> [reason]
- Description: Start a vote to kick a specific player.
- Permission: VOTEBAN.STARTKICK

### /addvote
- Description: Cast your vote for an active session.
- Permission: VOTEBAN.VOTE

### /votereload
- Description: Reloads the plugin configuration.
- Permission: VOTEBAN.RELOAD


## ✏️ Permissions

- VOTEBAN.*: Grants access to all plugin commands and features.
- VOTEBAN.RELOAD: Allows the user to reload the configuration file.
- VOTEBAN.BYPASS: Prevents a player from being targeted by any punishment votes.
- VOTEBAN.STARTBAN: Allows the player to initiate a vote to ban others.
- VOTEBAN.STARTKICK: Allows the player to initiate a vote to kick others.
- VOTEBAN.STARTMUTE: Allows the player to initiate a vote to mute others.
- VOTEBAN.VOTE: Allows the player to participate in active votes using /addvote.
- VOTEBAN.STOPCHAT: (Required if stop-chat is enabled in config) Allows the user to trigger a chat lockdown during a vote.
